facts.fact: Clement 到诊断病房找 Thumery，病房里都在传 gendarme 把 Head Healer Marcelle 带走问话，之后他没再回来上班
facts.anchor: gendarmes had come and fetched Head Healer Marcelle away to be questioned

facts.fact: Finvid Jonsson 说 Thumery 上午请了假却没离开医院（电车延误），在员工室地板打盹；自午间查房后没人再见到他
facts.anchor: He did take the morning off, but he didn’t leave the Hospital.

facts.fact: Clement 直问 Thumery 是否与 Ysabel 上床、他妻子是否知情；他承认妻子不知道，并说 Ysabel 曾威胁要全告诉她
facts.anchor: “I know you were sleeping with Ysabel,” they said. “Did your wife know too?”

facts.fact: Thumery 称考试前夜（Firstnight 前夜）他与妻子 Helene 都在家，当晚没有排练
facts.anchor: “The night before Firstnight? No, we were at home.”

facts.fact: 急诊伤者是 Palian 老公爵家之子、火法师，两周前在 Accademia Amolfe 与同学决斗时右大腿被火球击中，Harcot 只能把伤维持在静止状态
facts.anchor: He was hit in the right thigh by some sort of fireball spell.

facts.fact: Labaste 判定至少六人、最好十二人；Yariz 从病房下来担任主治疗放射首位，Clement 被排进监测与生命支持放射
facts.anchor: It’s at least a six-body problem, and I’d feel better with twelve

facts.fact: Brodier 告知 Clement：明晨资深教员开紧急会议，他们组最后两场考试改到下午最后时段
facts.anchor: Your exam group has had their time slot switched to the last one of the afternoon

facts.fact: Clement 探问 Ysabel 的研究笔记本下落，Brodier 说她原以为笔记本在 Clement 手里，因为 Ysabel 完全信任他
facts.anchor: I’d rather assumed you might have it, Savoye. She trusted you completely.
